lines: Kaura, the warden who was also my collaborator.
I had been saved by the guard unit she led, and arrived safely at Amidahara Prison.
The long, dangerous night grew bright, and a sturdy prison reminiscent of a fortress was illuminated by the glaring morning sun.
「First off, I'm gonna have you go through a body search here.」
I didn't know whether this was done with all the female prisoners, or it was a special case just with me, but either way, I was alone with Kaura.

It was a situation where it would be easy to converse with this woman, my collaborator. But taking her earlier, suggestive way of speaking into consideration, by the same token, precisely because there was no one else
here, I couldn't let my guard down.
「You can keep your clothes. Call it a special favour.」
「You won't need a collar and manacles in this prison.」
She said, and simply detached my collar and shackles.
I nodded, and Kaura happily added,
「I'm gonna have a seal put on you♪」
Her eyes were smiling with childlike glee.
「There's nothing but girls with troublesome powers locked up here, demon and Taimanin.」
「We put seals on those guys, to prevent them from running riot, using their powers however they like.」
「You're a Taimanin, so that means those Ninja Arts you specialize in won't be usable anymore.」
I see. She meant that, by some means or other, they would make any strange powers unusable.
Though she had said specialize, I couldn't use Ninja Arts in the first place, so there was no problem if they were sealed off.
However, my regenerative ability, which seemed to be a demonic power, might end up getting sealed off too.
「Um, could I not pretend to have been sealed?」
「You saying you wanna use your “one-time help” right away?」
「What happens is up to you. I'll help you only one time. Well, what will you do?」

If that regeneration ability were to be sealed off, then when push came to shove, I would no longer be able to act while resigned to being injured, and it would result in me having one fewer option for how to do things. But,
On the other hand, that would be the only risk to me.
Kaura nodded, without seeming like she particularly cared.
She seemed not to be the type to get too hung up on things.
There were all sorts of methods for that kind of sealing.
From the library at Gosha, I had knowledge about methods for sealing powers in the Demon World.
The most major ones were those where you signed a contract with a spell on it.
It was said that if you breached the terms and restrictions, you would be cursed. But could that really be?
What she liked was probably making it hurt. I could tell that just by looking at her face.
The eyes of Kaura (who, to all appearances, seemed to have an extremely sadistic mentality) were gleaming ominously.
Somehow, I had a bad feeling about this.
「It's a cursed item from Hell. I put these on three important places.」
「It's obvious what the important points on a woman are, right?♪」
Kaura gleefully pointed to my—or rather, Kirara-senpai's breasts and groin.
I hadn't tested where, and in what way, my original body corresponded to Kirara-senpai's body now, but
「'Cuz these piercings are connected to “invisible chains”, y'see?」
「The guards can pull on those chains at any time. Me too, o' course. It's agony.」
My voice reflexively came out at the thought of that pain, which I couldn't even imagine.
「What? It's fine. There're even some girls who get hooked on it, y'know?」
「If you're like that too, then just defy me. I'll make it hurt real good.」
If it were possible, I would have liked to pass on the cursed piercings themselves, but I had no choice but to accept them now.
「All right, I'm putting them on. Take off your clothes.」
「After you've put those on, what will happen if I use my abilities?」
「Extreme pain will wrack your entire body. Plus, if you try too hard to use 'em, your whole body'll be turned to stone by the curse.」
Her face looked like she was starting to get fed up.
「A Taimanin other than me's been imprisoned here, right? Just recently?」
「I figured he was a man. His name was Shikanosuke, after all.」
Furthermore, they had found out that he was a man.
「He was so cute, I wanted to eat him up. So...」
「I just threw him in prison as a female inmate.」
It was better than Shikanosuke being thrown into a place with nothing but male prisoners, huh?
He himself would probably get angry and ask why, though.
「Did you get incarcerated to rescue him?」
「What're the Taimanin plotting? Well, I don't care, though. C'mon, strip.」
I resolved myself, and began to remove my clothes.
I wasn't embarrassed, since it wasn't my body. But I did feel bad, so I apologized in my mind.
「Heeh, you're pretty nice. I figured a Taimanin would be covered in scars, but you've got a lovely body, don't you?♪」
Kaura was getting excited as she fiddled with the piercings. Give me a break!
However, she didn't seem to have noticed that, in that moment, there was another shadow that had suddenly slipped out of mine, and gone out of the examination room.
「Ta-daaa! It's Sakura-sensei in her new Taimanin suit!」
「Well, there's no one here, though, is there?」
The one who had struck a pose all by herself was Igawa Sakura, who had slipped out from Fuuma's shadow.
It was not the young Sakura, who was freeloading at his house.
It was the not-young...... No, sorry, the experienced Sakura, who was a teacher at Gosha.
She was said to even surpass her older sister, Asagi, when it came to hiding herself from view.
By making full use of her Shadow Escape Arts, she had masterfully evaded the eyes of the guards, and gotten into the prison's underground level easily.
「Maaan, Fuuma-kun's in big trouble, eh? Having them put three-point piercings on, out of nowhere...」
「I feel a little bad for him, but, you know... Fuuma-kun can learn the hardship of a Taimanin girl a little longer. Yeah, yeah.」
「It's fine, it's fine. Mere three-point piercings are no big deal. In Sakura-sensei's experience...... Anyway.」
「Now, while Fuuma-kun's distracting them, I have to carry out my own mission, don't I?」
While mumbling to herself, which anyone who didn't know her would think was just carelessness, Sakura examined her surroundings.
Countless enemy presences were drawing near, so as to surround her.
As well as low, bestial grunts.
「Hmmm, the info that there were no guards underground was accurate, but not precise, I guess.」
「Wonder if she didn't tell us on purpose? Am I wrong? That Kaura seems like the type not to care about the details, doesn't she......? At any rate...」
「I didn't hear anything about there being a big pack of demon dogs running free instead!」
